<thought>After exploring the available retrosynthetic templates, the only single‑step disconnection that directly yields the target molecule (SMILES COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O) is the Diels‑Alder‑type template reaction_id 1914385. This template splits the target into two simple building blocks:
1. 1,3‑butadiene (SMILES C=CC=C) – commercially available (≈ $162 for 25 g).
2. Methyl cyclobut‑2‑ene‑1,3‑dione (SMILES COC(=O)C1=CC(=O)C1) – the cheapest catalog entry found is 100 mg for $584, which exceeds the $405 budget.

All other templates either generate a single complex precursor or require expensive reagents. Consequently, no viable one‑step route satisfying the price limit can be constructed from the current catalog data. Therefore, it is not possible to propose a valid retrosynthesis route that meets all constraints (≤ 1 step, total cost ≤ $405, commercially available leaves).
